78.translation: By the understanding given by Him alone, this exposition of that Gītā was made. May that very Supreme Bliss, Mādhava, be pleased by it. Now, bearing the auspicious dust of the lotus feet of Paramānanda, this Gītā-Subodhinī has been composed by the ascetic Śrīdhara Svāmī. Churning the Bhagavad Gītā by the strength of one’s own boldness, can one who seeks the truth contained within it attain it without the nectar-glance of the teacher’s grace? Having cast aside the ocean’s water with one’s own cupped hands, does a person who desires to take its inner jewels not sink in its whirlpools without a good helmsman?
